peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: GOLD 65.5% with 3/3 replicate support; COPPER 24.1% with 3/3 replicate support; BTC 10.3% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Gold
peers.reason: The dominant return comparator and a direct precious-metal substitute. Gold captures the largest shared component of silver returns: US dollar direction, real yields, inflation hedging, investment demand, and safe-haven flows.

peers.name: Copper
peers.reason: Silver has heavy industrial demand in electronics, solar, and electrical applications, and much of global silver supply is a byproduct of base-metal mining; copper is the directly traded industrial metal that best captures this shared manufacturing-cycle and supply-side exposure, preferred over any corporate or leveraged proxy.

peers.name: Bitcoin
peers.reason: Bitcoin draws on the same alternative, non-fiat store-of-value demand that supports precious metals, making it a partial monetary-demand comparator, but it has no industrial-use linkage to silver, so it receives only a modest weight.

primary_index_hedge.name: Gold
primary_index_hedge.reason: Gold is the closest traded precious-metal substitute for silver: both are priced in US dollars and respond to real interest rates, inflation expectations, central-bank and investment demand, jewelry demand, and safe-haven flows. It is a commodity rather than an index, but it is the best risk hedge for silver's dominant monetary exposure. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is about 39.171 USD millions versus silver at about 47.704 USD millions, so it is executable; liquidity is treated only as a constraint.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
